instruction: Using the MDN Web Docs interface, search for CSS container queries and open the main guide. From that guide, navigate to the linked pages for container-type and container query length units. Report the steps required to establish a size-query container, the difference between size and style queries, all container query units listed with what each measures, and the fallback guidance for browsers without container-query-unit support. Stop after verifying each point from the three MDN pages through visible navigation and search. Do not use external search engines.
